runtime_connections_location_check.name: runtime_connections_location_check
runtime_connections_location_check.value: ("runtime_connections"."connection_type" = 'managed_cloud' and "runtime_connections"."location" = 'agent_hq_cloud' and "runtime_connections"."runtime_node_ref_id" is null) or ("runtime_connections"."connection_type" <> 'managed_cloud' and "runtime_connections"."location" = 'local_device' and "runtime_connections"."runtime_node_ref_id" is not null)
